title: Activation and functionalisation of carbon dioxide by bis-tris(pyrazolyl)borate-supported divalent samarium and trivalent lanthanide silylamide complexes

synthesis.procedure: In a N2 glovebox, [Sm(Tp)2(OTf)] (92.1 mg, 0.127 mmol, 1.0 eq.) in THF (3 mL) was treated with KC8 (34.4 mg, 0.255 mmol, 2.0 eq.) in portions over 2 min at ambient temperature and stirred for 0.5 h. The deep red-brown suspension was filtered, extracted with THF (2 mL), and the combined filtrates were evaporated. The red-brown solids containing [Sm(Tp)2(THF)2] were dried in vacuo (10^-2 mbar, 1 h), taken up in toluene (8 mL plus 1 mL extract), filtered to remove K(OTf), evaporated, and dried in vacuo (10^-2 mbar, 2 h) to give adduct-free [{Sm(Tp)2}n].
synthesis.time: 0.5 h stirring after KC8 addition; drying 1 h then 2 h
synthesis.vessel_or_method: 20 mL scintillation vial in an N2 glovebox
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtration to remove KC8/graphite and then K(OTf); solvents removed in vacuo and the dark-brown powder dried at 10^-2 mbar. The polymer is extremely poorly soluble; the THF adduct is an intermediate before toluene desolvation.

synthesis.procedure: The THF adduct is generated during reduction of [Sm(Tp)2(OTf)] (92.1 mg, 0.127 mmol, 1.0 eq.) with KC8 (34.4 mg, 0.255 mmol, 2.0 eq.) in THF (3 mL) at ambient temperature for 0.5 h, followed by filtration and evaporation. The red-brown solids containing [Sm(Tp)2(THF)2] were dried in vacuo (10^-2 mbar, 1 h) before toluene was used to desolvate them to polymeric 1-Sm. Lath-shaped red crystals of [Sm(Tp)2(THF)2]·THF were grown from saturated THF at -35 °C overnight.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: 20 mL scintillation vial in an N2 glovebox
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtered to exclude excess KC8 and graphite; THF removed in vacuo. Lath-shaped red single crystals from saturated THF at -35 °C overnight.

synthesis.procedure: [Sm(Tp)2(OTf)] (95.6 mg, 0.132 mmol, 1.0 eq.) and KC8 (35.5 mg, 0.263 mmol, 2.0 eq.) were used to generate 1-Sm(THF) in situ as for 1-Sm, and the product was extracted into toluene and filtered to remove K(OTf). Toluene (7.5 mL) was removed in vacuo and DME (0.5 mL) was added, immediately giving a dark violet-brown solution that was evaporated and dried in vacuo (10^-2 mbar, 2 h). Shard-shaped red crystals of [Sm(Tp)2(DME)]·toluene were grown from saturated toluene with hexane at -35 °C over three weeks.
synthesis.time: drying 2 h; crystallization over three weeks
synthesis.vessel_or_method: 20 mL scintillation vial in an N2 glovebox
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Toluene removed in vacuo, DME added, solution evaporated and powder dried at 10^-2 mbar for 2 h. Crystals from saturated toluene/hexane at -35 °C over three weeks.

synthesis.procedure: A dark red-brown d8-THF suspension of [Sm(Tp)2(DME)] (17.9 mg, 0.027 mmol) in a J. Young NMR tube was exposed for 1 min to dry CO2 (passed through a -78 °C dry-ice/2-propanol trap; system pressurised to 0.5 bar). Immediate decolourisation gave a white suspension. d8-THF (0.5 mL) was removed in vacuo and the pale cream solid was dried (10^-2 mbar, 1 h). Block-shaped colourless crystals were grown from saturated d8-THF with hexane at -35 °C over four months.
synthesis.time: 1 min CO2 exposure; drying 1 h; crystallization over four months
synthesis.vessel_or_method: J. Young NMR tube on a Schlenk line under the general CO2 protocol
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Solvent removed and solids dried in vacuo (10^-2 mbar, 1 h). Colourless block crystals from saturated d8-THF/hexane at -35 °C over four months.

synthesis.procedure: A colourless d6-benzene solution of [Y(Tp)2(N(SiMe3)2)] (21.5 mg, 0.032 mmol) was exposed to dry CO2 by the general NMR-tube protocol (0.5 bar, 1 min; CO2 passed through a -78 °C trap). No colour change was observed. d6-Benzene (0.5 mL) and dissolved O=C=NSiMe3 were removed in vacuo to a colourless oil. Hexane (1 mL) precipitated white solids, which were washed with hexane (1 mL), dried in vacuo (10^-2 mbar, 1 h). Rod-shaped colourless crystals were grown from saturated d6-benzene with hexane at -35 °C overnight.
synthesis.time: 1 min CO2 exposure; drying 1 h; crystallization overnight
synthesis.vessel_or_method: J. Young NMR tube on a Schlenk line under the general CO2 protocol
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Solvent and Me3SiNCO removed in vacuo; hexane precipitation and wash; drying at 10^-2 mbar for 1 h. Rod crystals from d6-benzene/hexane at -35 °C overnight.

synthesis.procedure: A white d6-benzene suspension of [Sm(Tp)2(N(SiMe3)2)] (18.5 mg, 0.025 mmol) was exposed to dry CO2 by the general NMR-tube protocol (0.5 bar, 1 min; CO2 passed through a -78 °C trap). No colour change was observed. d6-Benzene (0.5 mL) and dissolved O=C=NSiMe3 were removed in vacuo to a colourless oil. Hexane (1 mL) precipitated white solids, which were washed with hexane (1 mL) and dried in vacuo (10^-2 mbar, 1 h). Tablet-shaped colourless crystals were grown from saturated hexane at -35 °C over three months.
synthesis.time: 1 min CO2 exposure; drying 1 h; crystallization over three months
synthesis.vessel_or_method: J. Young NMR tube on a Schlenk line under the general CO2 protocol
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Solvent and Me3SiNCO removed in vacuo; hexane precipitation and wash; drying at 10^-2 mbar for 1 h. Tablet crystals from saturated hexane at -35 °C over three months.

synthesis.procedure: On one occasion a toluene solution of [Sm(Tp)2(N(SiMe3)2)] reacted with adventitious moisture to give [Sm5(Tp)6(μ2-OH)6(μ3-OH)2(μ4-OH)]. No reagent quantities or isolated yield are reported. Plate-shaped colourless crystals were grown from dilute hexane at -35 °C over a week.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Plate-shaped colourless single crystals from dilute hexane at -35 °C over a week. Connectivity-only structure is discussed with ESI Fig. S69.
